user_stories.description: Modify src/models/registry.py to automatically scan and import all model modules in the models directory when get_model() is called and registry is empty

user_stories.verification: Run: python -c 'from src.models.registry import get_model; print(get_model("causal_lob_forecaster", input_dim=40, horizon=5))'
